description: Aerial/drone still of a teal-green painted recessed doorway with louvered double doors, sunk below grade into a dry scrub-covered hillside and reached by a dirt path; low green retaining walls flank the sunken entry. The frame matches widely circulated July 2019 drone footage of Little St. James Island, U.S. Virgin Islands (Jeffrey Epstein's island), where the structure was presented online as a possible bunker or tunnel entrance. No text is visible in the image.
flags: Location inferred from context/companion frames, not shown in the image itself
